The '''Mercenary Elite prototype armor''' was a type of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] used by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian clans]] during both the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]]. One such notable owner of this armor was the now Mandalorian outcast [[Akaavi Spar]] during the Cold War as she traveled with the [[Voidhound]]'s crew though she would switch to the [[Mandalorian Seeker armor]] years later during the [[war against Zakuul]].
